author: Ryan Turbeville
title: Little Rock police arrest woman after infant dies at daycare - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Turbeville ,
3 hours ago
LITTLE ROCK, Ark. – Little Rock police said a woman was arrested in connection with an infant’s death after the child was found unresponsive at a daycare on Wednesday.
Little Rock Police Department officials said detectives were notified about an unresponsive infant at 8212 Frenchman Lane, which is the address of Hope Academy daycare.
When officers arrived, police said they found the infant inside of the daycare facility. Officials said the child died of their injuries at the scene.
Investigators said they later determined that 62-year-old Hope Jones was a suspect in the investigation. Officials added that she was later interviewed and is facing a charge for second-degree murder.
Authorities have not yet stated a possible cause of death for the infant.
This is a developing story. Please check back for updates.
